title: Investigate/resize macintel01 control-plane saturation — standing NodeCPUCritical/KubeAPIServerSlow since Aug (UTM VM on 2020 i7 Mac, apiserver ~3 cores idle, system/softirq-bound)
notes: Evidence 2026-10-15: macintel01 UTM VM (8 vCPU) pinned at 100-104% CPU with zero client traffic (30s apiserver_request delta empty), fresh apiserver restart rebaselines at ~18k goroutines, guest CPU steal=0 (not host contention), load avg 41, burn is system+softirq bound. Aug 2026 postmortem called this 'separate cause', never root-caused. Fix direction: bigger control-plane VM or move off the shared 2020 Mac host.
